sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next model card
sources.evidence: Exact instruct checkpoint: open weights; Apache-2.0 metadata; nominal 80B total and 3B activated; hybrid Gated DeltaNet/attention with MoE; 262144 context; non-thinking; tool calling.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3NextForCausalLM architecture with linear-attention dimensions and full_attention_interval=4.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next: Pushing Small Hybrid Models on Agentic Coding
sources.evidence: Primary announcement text available through search indexing, dated 2026/02/02; direct page extraction was empty. Describes open-weight coding-agent model derived from Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next commit history
sources.evidence: Initial weights uploaded January 30; model-card announcement updates February 3. Upload timestamps do not independently establish first public availability.

sources.title: Official Qwen organization
sources.evidence: Organization identifies Qwen as the language-model family built by Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder official repository
sources.evidence: Lists Qwen3-Coder-Next as an instruct checkpoint, distinct from Next-Base and quantizations; describes coding-agent training and function-call integration.

developer.note: Alibaba Cloud develops the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Only month asserted: indexed announcement says February 2; public card updates and citation say February 3. Exact launch day unresolved.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer nominal activated count, in billions; not inferred.

architecture.note: Hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, each with MoE; not a conventional attention-only transformer.

modalities.note: Text causal language model with tokenizer-based generation.

reasoning.note: Explicitly supports non-thinking mode only; this flag does not deny general reasoning ability.

tool_call.note: Dedicated function-call parser and usage example.

description.value: Open-weight Qwen coding model for agents, repository edits, and multi-turn tool use
description.note: Supported by coding-agent purpose, tool integration and long-horizon training; no benchmark claim.

patch.notes: Counts are nominal publisher figures for the exact Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next instruct checkpoint. Architecture combines Gated DeltaNet and gated attention with MoE. Hosted aliases may have distinct deployment revisions; no byte-identical hosted checkpoint mapping is asserted. Announcement indexing says February 2, while model-card release material is dated February 3; only month precision is asserted.

summary: Confirmed exact open instruct checkpoint: nominal 80B total / 3B activated, MoE with hybrid attention, Apache-2.0, native 262144 context, text I/O, non-thinking and tool support. Reduced release precision to February 2026 because primary announcement indexing and repository release material disagree by one day. Hosted deployment equivalence is not asserted.
